pinning.reason: All three artifacts were fetched and hashed first-hand at the pinned revision on 2026-11-14: emo.tflite 10,222,736 B (matches the repository LFS metadata), emo_tokenizer.bin 733,197 B and emo_meta.json 6,280 B. The label order (812 emojis) and the n-gram/semantic constants come from emo_meta.json; the tokenizer, feature and tensor facts were read from the primary source named in contractSource and confirmed by the processor owner (litert-provider, task-25) under the Lead's binding emo contract decisions. The gated real run in the runtime-litert package qualifies execution.

qualification.tokenizer: EMTK SemTokenizer (emo_tokenizer.bin), Viterbi maxLen 24, NFKC lowercase, sem_pad_index 48000
qualification.processor: emo/text-v1 (contract confirmed 2026-11-14 by the Lead and litert-provider): host-side SemTokenizer parses emo_tokenizer.bin as EMTK (magic EMTK, offset 6, u32 unkID, u32 k, k float32 scores, k uint16 piece lengths, UTF-8 pieces back to back) and runs Viterbi over scalars (maxLen 24) on NFKC-lowercased text prefixed with '▁' with spaces mapped to '▁' and an unknown fallback at the unk score, producing at most smax 64 ids padded with sem_pad_index 48000 and a float32 [1,64] mask; host-side NGram hashing uses FNV-64 with the five bucket seeds and importance seed 0xFF51AFD7ED558CCD over per-script features, fmax 512 features and 3 hashes each, producing ngram_buckets int32 [1,512,3], ngram_signs float32 [1,512,3], ngram_importance int32 [1,512] and ngram_count float32 [1,1]. The six feeds go to emo.tflite; the output is probabilities float32 [812]. Suggestions are the top `limit` labels by descending probability with exact ties broken by ascending label index; confidence is the label's raw softmax probability and is explicitly uncalibrated; emoji strings are read from emo_meta.json labels[index] and never hardcoded; labels.length must be 812 and a provider-side count mismatch (meta labels vs model logits) is RuntimeUnavailable, not a truncation. Input text is counted in Unicode code points ([...text].length) and must be 1..1024; empty or whitespace-only text is refused as InvalidInput (field text). v1 applies no skin-tone variant. Recipe limits are 4194304 bytes / 120000 ms; the tool does not return a language; the model card's '23 languages' claim is card-sourced (Emo.swift L38-43), not measured. The provider constructs exactly {suggestions:[{emoji,confidence}], labels:812}; the host lane owns the JSON-schema check.
